blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Defense ministers from the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) adopted statements and five new initiatives to strengthen regional security cooperation. Philippine Defense Secretary Gilberto Teodoro Jr. announced the outcomes of the 20th ASEAN Defence Ministers’ Meeting (ADMM) and the 13th ASEAN Defence Ministers’ Meeting-Plus (ADMM-Plus) during a press conference in Lapu-Lapu City on Thursday afternoon, October 29. The initiatives, which include exchanges among young defense leaders, joint resilience against chemical, biological and radiological threats, and closer coordination between two regional security platforms, form part of a broader set of agreements and activities aimed at developing ASEAN’s […]...
